title: Understanding LASSO Regularization
text: LASSO regularization adds a penalty to the loss function based on the absolute values of the coefficients. This can lead to some coefficients being reduced to zero, effectively selecting a simpler model.

title: Effect on Training MSE
text: Consider how adding a penalty term to the loss function might affect the model's fit to the training data. Will it always fit the training data better, worse, or could it vary?

title: Analyzing Training MSE with LASSO
text: When LASSO regularization is applied, the model may not fit the training data as closely as an unregularized model. What does this imply about the training MSE?
